SELECT d.row_id, d.source_id, d.version_id, d.xml_object AS device_xml, s.xml_object AS server_xml FROM lcsample.submission_versions d JOIN lcsample.submission_versions s ON d.run_id=s.run_id AND d.form_id=s.form_id AND d.version_id=s.version_id AND s.side='server' AND s.source_id='server-snapshot-fleet' WHERE d.run_id='sample-fleet-2026' AND d.form_id='household_survey' AND d.side='device' AND d.source_id IN ('device-snapshot-tablet-01','device-snapshot-tablet-02','device-snapshot-tablet-03','device-snapshot-tablet-04') AND d.xml_object<>s.xml_object LIMIT 1001
